preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 400.
Each n must be a power of 2 and within the range from 4 to 65536.
The value of k must be between 0 and n-1 for each test case.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any((a & b) for a, b in pairs) == k else True
postconditions.description: If no valid pairs can be formed, output -1; otherwise, output the pairs.

postconditions.expression: len(pairs) == n // 2 and all(len(set(pair)) == 2 for pair in pairs)
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n/2 pairs, each containing two distinct elements.

postconditions.expression: sum(a & b for a, b in pairs) == k
postconditions.description: The sum of the bitwise AND of all pairs must equal k.
